fact: The Council of Ministers communiqué of 11 October 2025 states that Niger equipped itself in 2022 with a national cybersecurity strategy, aiming at a secure and resilient cyberspace.
system: Stratégie Nationale en matière de cybersécurité (2022)

fact: The Council of Ministers adopted on 11 October 2025 the decrees creating the Centre National de Cybersécurité (CNAC) as a public administrative establishment and approving its statutes, to coordinate national cybersecurity strategy including critical systems.
Le Sahel reports a panellist at the April 2026 Niger IGF saying Niger 's'est doté' of a National Cybersecurity Strategy for 2023-2027, with four axes, to be implemented by the CNAC.
